SableFixCorecore.panel.about_ver: Sable Fix Core — deadlock forensics & save repair
SableFixCorecore.panel.about_what1: Sable (Aeronautics) ships and airships live in separate sublevel files.
SableFixCorecore.panel.about_what2: Corrupted pointers there fail silently — structures just vanish;
SableFixCorecore.panel.about_what3: and a stalled server gets killed by the vanilla watchdog after 60 s,
SableFixCorecore.panel.about_what4: with zero clues — you never know what hung. This mod captures the evidence when it hangs, and one-click-repairs broken saves.
SableFixCorecore.panel.about_passive1: 1. Verifies every slvlr/slvls pointer table at startup;
SableFixCorecore.panel.about_passive2: 2. Parses force-load tickets, counts and damage at a glance;
SableFixCorecore.panel.about_passive3: 3. Everything is logged to the Runtime Log tab.
SableFixCorecore.panel.about_watch1: A healthy main thread ticks 20 times a second. After 20 s of silence,
SableFixCorecore.panel.about_watch2: it writes a full thread dump to logs/SableFixCorecore/ — before the 60 s kill,
SableFixCorecore.panel.about_watch3: so next time it stalls, open the report and you see
SableFixCorecore.panel.about_watch4: exactly who is waiting on whom. No more guessing.
SableFixCorecore.panel.about_readonly1: Checks are read-only; repair via /SableFixCorecore repair <file> dry|apply (preview first),
SableFixCorecore.panel.about_readonly2: batch repair-all, ticket purge — always backed up before a single byte is touched.
SableFixCorecore.panel.about_cmds2: Panel auto-refreshes every 30 s; stall dumps re-taken every 5 min, 50 kept max.
